team.member.import.brief: Add people to the console from a list
team.member.import.description: Paste a list of people — name and email in any shape, or the ids of uploaded files — and everyone in it gets an account, the chosen role, a staff card and a sign-in link. Running the same list twice adds nobody twice. Roles: manager, operator, viewer. Answers with the table of exactly these people.

team.member.setRole.description: Give a person a different role. Roles are preset files; owner cannot be handed out this way. Needs a team member in context.

team.member.deactivate.description: Mark a person as no longer working here and revoke their open invitation. A token already issued keeps working until it expires. Needs a team member in context.

team.member.create.brief: File a card for one person
team.member.create.description: Record somebody who works here without giving them console access. Use the import when they need to sign in.

team.invite.revoke.description: Shut an address out before the invitation has been used. Takes effect at once. Needs an invitation in context.
